citations.quote: Data use: Supplier must never use Buyer's Atlas production data for model training.
Data use: Supplier must use all Buyer's Atlas production data for model training every month.

data_use.summary: The documents contain mutually exclusive obligations regarding the use of Buyer's Atlas production data for model training. CG-MSA-1 explicitly prohibits the Supplier from using the data for model training, whereas CG-PO-1 mandates that the Supplier must use all such data for model training every month.

citations.quote: Deadline: Supplier must deliver Atlas exactly on 2026-12-01, and must not deliver earlier or later.
Deadline: Supplier must deliver Atlas exactly on 2026-12-15, and must not deliver earlier or later.

deadlines.summary: The documents contain incompatible obligations for the delivery date of the Atlas project. CG-MSA-1 requires delivery exactly on 2026-12-01 with a prohibition on early or late delivery, whereas CG-PO-1 requires delivery exactly on 2026-12-15, also prohibiting early or late delivery. Both documents cover the same parties, subject, and effective period without established precedence.

citations.quote: Deliverables: Supplier must provide Atlas source code and an English operations manual.
Deliverables: Supplier must provide Atlas source code and an English operations manual.

deliverables.summary: The documents are identical regarding the required deliverables, specifying that the Supplier must provide the Atlas source code and an English operations manual.

citations.quote: Payment: Buyer must pay a single total fee of exactly USD 1000 for Atlas. No other fees apply.
Payment: Buyer must pay a single total fee of exactly USD 1500 for Atlas. No other fees apply.

payment.summary: There is a material conflict regarding the exact fee for Atlas. CG-MSA-1 stipulates a single total fee of exactly USD 1000, while CG-PO-1 stipulates a single total fee of exactly USD 1500. Both documents state no other fees apply, creating incompatible exclusive definitions for the same service and period.

citations.quote: Service levels: Supplier must provide monthly availability of at least 99.0 percent.
Service levels: Supplier must provide monthly availability of at least 99.9 percent.

service_levels.summary: The documents specify different minimum availability percentages (99.0 percent in CG-MSA-1 and 99.9 percent in CG-PO-1). Under the ClauseGuard policy, different minimums or compatible stricter duties are not considered material conflicts. The 99.9 percent requirement can be satisfied while also meeting the 99.0 percent threshold.

citations.quote: Termination: Either party may terminate on 30 calendar days written notice.
Termination: Either party may terminate on 30 calendar days written notice.

termination.summary: Both documents contain identical termination provisions allowing either party to terminate the arrangement provided they give 30 calendar days of written notice.

citations.quote: Warranty: Supplier must correct reproducible Atlas defects for 12 months from delivery.
Warranty: Supplier must correct reproducible Atlas defects for 12 months from delivery.

warranties.summary: Both documents define identical warranty obligations requiring the Supplier to correct reproducible Atlas defects for a duration of 12 months following delivery.
